entities.name: Mikołaj "the Red" Radziwiłł
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mikołaj Radziwiłł, nicknamed the Red, was a Polish–Lithuanian nobleman who served as the voivode of Vilnius, Grand Chancellor of Lithuania, and Grand Lithuanian Hetman in the Grand Duchy of Lithuania and later the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth. Together with his cousin Mikołaj "the Black" Radziwiłł and the Radziwiłł family, they were granted title and position as Prince of the Holy Roman Empire.
